description:
ARCHITECTURE.md has three gaps surfaced while scoping v0.5 UI. This task closes them before we write any UI code, so the frontend/backend contract is pinned down structurally rather than emerging from the implementation.

=== What the spec currently says (and why it's wrong) ===

1. §3.2 Components lists Harness / Tool executor / Provider adapter / UI flat. There is no named backend/frontend split. The pluggability story (swappable renderers, a future webclient running alongside a desktop app) is not structural in the spec — it is aspirational by omission.

2. §3.1 says 'UI tails .agent/state/events.log' and 'UI → Harness (user actions written to an input directory, harness picks up)'. Both are wrong against how the system should work:
   - The UI watches many files (git state, branches.json, tool output, invocation dirs, goal files, compactions) — the filesystem itself is the event stream, inotify is the notifier. A single events.log is neither necessary nor sufficient.
   - 'Input directory' contradicts §3.4 / PRINCIPLES 'Everyone uses the front door'. Commands go through the lernie CLI, not a shared input path.

3. Strict frontend statelessness is nowhere stated. Every render must be a pure function of filesystem state at the current git ref. No cache, no shadow model. Without this, swappable frontends and running several in parallel don't actually work.

=== What to change ===

- §3.2: upgrade the 'Harness' definition to name it as the sole component performing external↔file interactions (providers, tools, subprocesses), and note 'also called the daemon' as a synonym so casual usage redirects to the canonical term. Upgrade 'UI' to name it as a stateless renderer that watches the repo filesystem and issues commands via the lernie CLI; note 'also called the frontend' as a synonym. Pluggability is structural: N frontends may run concurrently against one harness.

- §3.1: remove the 'UI tails events.log' line; replace with 'UI watches paths in the conversation repo; inotify (with polling fallback) notifies on change'. Remove 'UI → Harness via input directory'; replace with 'UI → Harness via lernie CLI invocations, per §3.4'. Events.log remains for harness-internal bookkeeping but is not the UI's primary input.

- New subsection (probably §3.5, 'Frontend contract' — or folded into §7) stating:
   - Frontend is strictly stateless.
   - Interface surface is exactly (a) a set of filesystem paths in the conversation repo the frontend reads + watches, and (b) the lernie CLI subcommands it invokes. No other channel.
   - Multiple frontends may run concurrently over one repo.

- §7.1 'Live view': replace 'tails events.log' with 'watches filesystem'. Keep the rest.

- PRINCIPLES.md: add one line (or extend an existing one) noting the frontend-statelessness + pluggability contract. It's a direct consequence of 'Disk first' and 'Everyone uses the front door' and deserves to be called out.

=== Out of scope ===

- Any code changes. This is a doc-only revision.
- Picking the concrete watched-paths list or the concrete CLI surface the UI will use. Those get pinned down by the v0.5 epic itself.
- Rewording §3.4 — already correct.

=== Testing ===

Doc-only change. cargo test + tarpaulin still pass (they should be untouched). Read-through to check internal consistency: no stale reference to 'input directory' or 'tails events.log' anywhere else in the doc.

=== Why now ===

Blocks the v0.5 UI epic. Also low-cost to do in parallel with v0.2/v0.3 work since it touches no code.
title: ARCH: harness/UI roles + filesystem-as-event-stream + pluggability
